+    def _run_async(self, coro):
+        try:
+            asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            return asyncio.run(coro)
+
+        result = {}
+        error = {}
+
+        def runner():
+            try:
+                result["value"] = asyncio.run(coro)
+            except BaseException as exc:
+                error["exc"] = exc
+
+        thread = threading.Thread(target=runner)
+        thread.start()
+        thread.join()
+
+        if "exc" in error:
+            raise error["exc"]
+
+        return result["value"]
+
+    async def _query_json(self, base_url: str, params: dict[str, Any]):
+        request_kwargs = dict(self._request_kwargs)
+
+        proxy = request_kwargs.pop("proxy", None)
+        proxies = request_kwargs.pop("proxies", None)
+        if proxy is None and proxies:
+            proxy = proxies.get("https") or proxies.get("http")
+        if proxy is not None:
+            request_kwargs["proxy"] = proxy
+
+        verify = request_kwargs.pop("verify", None)
+        if verify is not None and "ssl" not in request_kwargs:
+            if isinstance(verify, str):
+                request_kwargs["ssl"] = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=verify)

+                request_kwargs["ssl"] = verify
+
+        timeout = request_kwargs.pop("timeout", 10.0)
